items.headline: WWT recaps NetApp Insight, including two partner-of-the-year awards
items.summary: WWT published a Nov. 17 recap of NetApp Insight 2026. WWT said NetApp announced a renewed AI Data Engine that works across a customer's data estate, not only data stored on NetApp, after acquiring DataPelago, and that NetApp claims its Novus system delivers 100 terabytes per second and can feed 50,000 GPUs at 2 gigabytes per second each. WWT said that on Oct. 1, at Insight, NetApp named WWT its fiscal 2026 North America Partner of the Year and AI Partner of the Year. WWT also said NetApp added Oracle Cloud Infrastructure as a first-party ONTAP service, alongside AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud.
